title: Mbappé v Henry at exactly the same age
checked: Real Madrid at AEK Athens, 4 Nov 2026 (UEFA + Foot Africa). Mbappé born 20 Dec 1998 = 27 years 319 days. Henry born 17 Aug 1977 reached that age on 2 Jul 2005, in the summer, so his totals are exact: Monaco 105 games 20 goals, Juventus 16/3, Arsenal 205/137 = 326 league games, 160 league goals. Mbappé senior league games to 1 Nov 2026: Monaco 41/16, PSG 205/175, Real Madrid 76/68 = 322 games, 259 goals (reserve team left out). Both from Wikipedia career tables (one source each). Henry's Arsenal record 175 league goals (Wikipedia). Mbappé's 2026 World Cup Golden Boot (Wikipedia + Sortiraparis). Minutes not confirmable, so the twist uses games.

lines.text: On the fourth of November, when Real Madrid play in Athens, Kylian Mbappé is twenty-seven years and three hundred and nineteen days old.

scene.heading: KYLIAN MBAPPÉ
scene.sub: AEK Athens v Real Madrid · 4 Nov 2026

lines.text: France's greatest striker before him? Thierry Henry. So where was Henry at exactly that age?
July twenty oh-five. Two Golden Boots in a row at Arsenal, an Invincibles season behind him.
His league goals at that age: one hundred and sixty, for Monaco, Juventus and Arsenal.
Mbappé at the same age? Two hundred and fifty-nine.
That's ninety-nine more league goals than the man who holds Arsenal's scoring record.
Now the twist. Maybe Mbappé just played more? Let's match the games.

scene.heading: MATCH THE GAMES
scene.body: League games at the same age. Mbappé: 322. Henry: 326.

lines.text: Henry had actually played four more league games. Almost exactly the same.
So in the same number of games, Mbappé scored ninety-nine more goals.
Henry started out on the wing at Monaco and Juventus. Mbappé was scoring from day one.
Is Mbappé already better than Henry? Tell me in the comments.

scene.text: Ninety-nine more? Fine. But I had the Invincibles.
